scope_review_hold.evidence: B01 line212.2 opening investment in subsidiary 535,881,668 VND, ending nil; B03 line64 proceeds from sale of investment in subsidiary/joint venture/associate 535,881,668 VND. Separate company-only statements, not consolidated.

items.core_financial_extraction_note: BCTC riêng lẻ Q1/2025 xác minh trực quan. B01/B02/B03 raw VND đều khớp. B01 current assets + noncurrent = assets; current liabilities + long-term = liabilities; total assets = liabilities + equity. B02 revenue/expense/profit/tax/PAT reconciled. B03 CFO+CFI+CFF = net cash and opening cash + net cash = closing cash. Parentheses negative; printed dash zero; FX line102 absent = null. Customer flows on PDF page14 excluded.
items.financial_line_items_note: VCK Q1/2025 PDF gốc là BCTC riêng lẻ của Công ty Cổ phần Chứng khoán VPS, được phân loại từ B01 line212.2 và B03 line64 về khoản đầu tư vào công ty con. Đơn vị trên B01/B02/B03 là VND; note 2.1 xác nhận đồng tiền ghi sổ VND. Snapshot triệu VND chỉ sau khi kiểm tra raw. Cột B02 Q1/2025 là cột quý hiện hành. B03 CFO/CFI âm trong ngoặc, CFF dương; line102 FX không được trình bày nên null. Tiền hoạt động môi giới/ủy thác khách hàng tại PDF page14 là báo cáo riêng và bị loại khỏi dòng tiền doanh nghiệp.

core_financial_extraction_calculations.cashBridge: Opening cash 1,732,141,826,349 - net cash change 108,726,932,724 = ending cash 1,623,414,893,625 VND.
core_financial_extraction_calculations.scope: B01 row212.2 subsidiary investment opening 535,881,668 VND, quarter close nil; B03 row64 proceeds from disposal 535,881,668 VND. Separate statements.

scope_evidence.evidence: PDF cover page 1 identifies Báo cáo tài chính quý II of Công ty Cổ phần Chứng khoán VPS and does not label the report consolidated. B01/B02/B03 pages 5–6 and 8–13 are headed with the company name only. Notes page 17 section 2.3 explicitly says the financial statements are prepared from transactions and accounting records of the Company and refers to the company's own internal balances being eliminated; it does not identify a consolidated reporting entity. B01 page 5 line 212.2 shows opening investment in subsidiary 535,881,668 VND and nil closing balance; B03 page 13 line 64 shows recovery proceeds of 535,881,668 VND. These support the separate-company scope.

unit_evidence.evidence: B01 pages 5–6, B02 pages 8–11 and B03 pages 12–13 explicitly label VND. Notes page 16 section 2.1 confirms Đồng Việt Nam (VND) as the accounting currency. Snapshot values are raw VND divided by 1,000,000; reconciliation is performed before rounding.
unit_evidence.conversion: Raw VND / 1,000,000; rounding only after raw-VND reconciliation.
